hero.tagline: Apps for two educational institutions in Chelyabinsk: electronic grade book, schedule, student portfolio, document management. Two roles — student and faculty.

seo.title: URC & SUTU — mobile student app on React Native
seo.description: Apps for students and faculty: grades, schedules, portfolios, offline access.

overview.title: About the project
overview.description: Mobile apps for South Ural Technological University (SUTU) and Ural Regional College (URC). Students check grades and schedules, faculty manage gradebooks and upload materials.

solution.title: What was built
solution.description: Two React Native apps with dual-role architecture.

features.title: Student cabinet
features.description: Electronic grade book, class schedule, portfolio with work uploads, tuition payment information.

features.title: Faculty cabinet
features.description: Gradebook management, course material uploads, student communication.

features.title: Offline access
features.description: Critical data (schedule, grades) available without internet, synced when back online.

impact.title: Outcome
impact.description: Apps deployed at two educational institutions in Chelyabinsk.

achievements.title: Two institutions

achievements.title: Offline mode
